responsibility: Defines the MMIX backend’s machine constraints used by RTL recognition, reload, and instruction selection. This file assigns register-constraint letters to MMIX special-register classes and describes the immediate, symbolic-address, frame-pointer, and address forms that MMIX patterns in mmix.md accept, including wyde-loadable constants, zero values, base-address-sensitive symbolic references, and valid memory-address operands consumed by recog and reload.
